t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Basically the gnomes come in pairs and it's important to keep track of their colours. Other features such as their hats or sizes don't matter. Some gnomes within a pair lead to a bright forest, others lead to a dark forest, and it's recommended paying attention to which forests give out more mushrooms on average. The number of mushrooms within a forest changes with each round.

vb_textbox.text: Hi! There are two main features of this game.First important one is that the gnomes will appear in pairs: orange and brown, green and pink, red and yellow, blue and purple. That is the only thing you have to pay attention to. Their position within each level, hat type or their sizes are irrelevant.Some of the gnomes lead to a bright forest, while others lead to a dark one. The orange, red, blue and green gnomes lead to the bright one, while the brown, pink, yellow and purple ones take you to the dark forest. This is the second feature of the game.The number of mushrooms in a forest changes, but the changes are somewhat predictable. I suggest experimenting a bit with the x1 multipliers, and try to guess it right with the x5.That's everything I've got to say. Good luck!
